jurisdiction.name: Myanmar
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: No national AI law, strategy or AI guidance from the Myanmar government has been identified on official sites. The telecommunications regulator under the communications ministry lists the ASEAN Guide on AI Governance and Ethics among its codes of practice and guidelines, but this is a regional document rather than a national one. The 2025 Cybersecurity Law appears to contain no AI provisions. A Digital Economy Roadmap 2030 and a Digital Government Master Plan may contain AI content.
narrative.review_notes: Not yet verified from the official text: the 2025 Cybersecurity Law, the Digital Economy Roadmap 2030 and the Digital Government Master Plan 2023-2030. Official sources checked in October 2026 include the telecommunications regulator, the cyber emergency team, the central bank and the foreign affairs and education ministries, with no national AI documents identified; still to check: the national legislation portal, parliament and the planning and finance ministry websites.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Myanmar's laws, government, ministries and the central bank were searched in English and Burmese for AI laws, strategies and guidance. No qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category; an unofficial translation of the cybersecurity law shows no AI provisions, and two digital plans are listed as leads. The official text of the cybersecurity law remains to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. mlis.gov.mm reset/503; motc.gov.mm HTTP 521; mopf.gov.mm refused/unresolvable; mofa.gov.mm, mcf.gov.mm and mdeb.gov.mm unreachable. cbm.gov.mm reached (no AI results). Cybersecurity Law No. 1/2025 checked only in an unofficial translation (no AI terms); not recorded. Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched for AI laws and AI provisions (English and Burmese). The Myanmar Law Information System (mlis.gov.mm) was unreachable (connection reset; HTTP 503). The Cybersecurity Law (Law No. 1/2025, in force 30 July 2025 by Notification 113/2025) was checked via a discovery copy of its English translation: no AI, algorithm or deepfake provisions, so not recorded. No data protection law with automated-decision rules; no AI bill found. Searched, nothing found.; Government: No national AI strategy, AI policy, AI governance framework or public-sector AI guidance found. Digital Economy Roadmap 2030 and Digital Government Master Plan 2023-2030 held as leads (AI content unverified; official sites unreachable).; Ministries: Ministry of Transport and Communications (motc.gov.mm returned HTTP 521), Ministry of Planning and Finance (unreachable), Ministry of Foreign Affairs (connection reset); education, science and technology, health searched by web search: no AI documents found.; Regulators: Central Bank of Myanmar site search for 'artificial intelligence' and 'AI': no results. No separate data protection authority exists; cyber security functions sit with the ministry under the Cybersecurity Law; no AI-specific regulator documents found.. Not reached: mlis.gov.mm (legislation portal) unreachable; motc.gov.mm unreachable (HTTP 521); mopf.gov.mm unreachable (proxy CONNECT refused; WebFetch DNS failure); mofa.gov.mm (connection reset); mcf.gov.mm, mdeb.gov.mm unreachable. Could not verify: Official text of the Cybersecurity Law 2025 on mlis.gov.mm (portal unreachable); absence of AI provisions based on an unofficial English translation used for discovery only. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found. Local retry 2026-10-18 (Saudi home connection, curl with Chrome UA, headless Edge fallback, ~20-minute box): OPENED: ptd.gov.mm (Posts and Telecommunications Department; laws, frameworks/policies, codes of practice/guidelines, orders and public-consultation listings scanned; only AI item is 'ASEAN Guide on AI Governance and Ethics' posted 8 May 2024 under codes of practice/guidelines, a regional ASEAN instrument, not recorded nationally; frameworks list holds ASEAN ADM 2030 and spectrum/IX documents, no national AI item; consultations list has no AI item; homepage names the parent ministry as the Ministry of Digital Development and Communications); mmcert.org.mm (200; news items only, incl. a deepfake-fraud alert and an ASEAN GeoAI contest notice, no AI guidance); mofa.gov.mm (200, now reachable; no AI documents); cbm.gov.mm (200); moi.gov.mm, moe.gov.mm, mod.gov.mm, dica.gov.mm (200, home only). STILL FAILED: mlis.gov.mm (connect timeout on https/http, with and without www; headless Edge timeout); motc.gov.mm (HTTP 521; Edge ERR_CONNECTION_RESET); mopf.gov.mm (DNS not resolved, so the Digital Economy Roadmap PDF could not be fetched); mdeb.gov.mm, mcf.gov.mm, most.gov.mm, mohs.gov.mm, myanmar.gov.mm, pyidaungsu.hluttaw.mm (no connection); mddc.gov.mm guessed domain not resolving; gnlm.com.mm 403 (newspaper, not a source anyway). leads.title: Myanmar Digital Economy Roadmap 2030
leads.issuing_authority: Digital Economy Development Committee (chaired under the de facto authorities' administration)
leads.note: Reported as launched in December 2024 (strategic pillars and 77 action plans); a roadmap PDF is linked from the Ministry of Planning and Finance site (mopf.gov.mm 'RoadMap for Websites.pdf'), but mopf.gov.mm and motc.gov.mm could not be reached on 2026-10-12 (curl and WebFetch both failed), so its AI content, title and date are unverified. Check whether it contains an AI pillar or AI action items; record as strategy only if it does. 2026-10-18: mopf.gov.mm still could not be reached (host name does not resolve), and the communications regulator's frameworks and policies list does not carry the roadmap; AI content still unverified.
